# Data Import

```{r}
# Read in covariate data
covarData <- read.csv(file = "GSE85307_covar-1.csv")

# Read in gene expression data
geneExpression <- read.csv(file = "GSE85307_geneExpression.csv",
                           row.names = 1)

# Read in gene name linker
geneNames <- read.csv(file = "GSE85307_geneNames.csv",
                      row.names = 1)

# Check dimensions
dim(covarData)
dim(geneExpression)
dim(geneNames)

# Check that sample IDs match
all(covarData$geoID %in% colnames(geneExpression))
all(colnames(geneExpression) %in% covarData$geoID)
```

# Selected Genes

```{r}
# Store selected genes
selectedGenes <- c("TBL1X",
                   "KDM1B",
                   "TMEM176B")

# Identify probe IDs using R
geneProbeMap <- geneNames[
  geneNames$GENE %in% selectedGenes,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

# Save probe IDs from row names
geneProbeMap$PROBEID <- rownames(geneProbeMap)

# Put genes in selected order
geneProbeMap <- geneProbeMap[
  match(selectedGenes,
        geneProbeMap$GENE),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

# Check probe IDs
geneProbeMap

# Verify that all selected genes were found
all(selectedGenes %in%
      geneProbeMap$GENE)

# Verify that all probe IDs are in expression data
all(geneProbeMap$PROBEID %in%
      rownames(geneExpression))
```

# Data Wrangling

```{r}
# Create project data frame
projectData <- covarData

# Remove text from BMI values
projectData$mat_BMI <- sub(
  "bmi_kg/m2: ",
  "",
  projectData$mat_BMI
)

# Convert BMI to numeric
projectData$mat_BMI <- as.numeric(
  projectData$mat_BMI
)

# Calculate median BMI
medianBMI <- median(
  projectData$mat_BMI,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

# Create categorical BMI variable
# Labels incorporate Submission 1 feedback
projectData$BMIgroup <- cut(
  projectData$mat_BMI,
  breaks = c(-Inf,
             medianBMI,
             Inf),
  labels = c("Below Median BMI",
             "Above Median BMI")
)

# Remove text from vitamin D values
projectData$mat_vitD <- sub(
  "vitamind_25\\(0h\\)_ng/ml_whole_blood_baseline: ",
  "",
  projectData$mat_vitD
)

# Convert vitamin D to numeric
projectData$mat_vitD <- as.numeric(
  projectData$mat_vitD
)

# Remove text from pregnancy outcome values
projectData$preg_preeclampsia <- sub(
  "pregnancy_condition: ",
  "",
  projectData$preg_preeclampsia
)

# Set pregnancy outcome order
projectData$preg_preeclampsia <- factor(
  projectData$preg_preeclampsia,
  levels = c("Normal",
             "Preeclampsia")
)

# Check cleaned variables
summary(projectData$mat_BMI)
summary(projectData$mat_vitD)
table(projectData$BMIgroup)
table(projectData$preg_preeclampsia)
```

# Add Selected Gene Expression

```{r}
# Select expression rows using probe IDs identified in R
selectedExpression <- geneExpression[
  geneProbeMap$PROBEID,
  projectData$geoID,
  drop = FALSE
]

# Replace probe IDs with gene names
rownames(selectedExpression) <-
  geneProbeMap$GENE

# Transpose so genes become columns
selectedExpression <-
  as.data.frame(
    t(selectedExpression)
  )

# Combine covariate and expression data
analysisData <- cbind(
  projectData,
  selectedExpression
)

# Check selected gene values
summary(
  analysisData[, selectedGenes]
)

# Check categorical variables
table(analysisData$BMIgroup)
table(analysisData$preg_preeclampsia)
```

# Plotting Function

```{r}
buildGenePlots <- function(data, geneList) {

  # Create empty list to store plots
  plotList <- list()

  # Loop through each gene
  for (gene in geneList) {

    # Make a temporary copy of the data
    tempData <- data

    # Save current gene expression in one column
    tempData$geneExpression <-
      tempData[, gene]

    # Create italicized gene labels
    geneAxis <- TeX(
      paste0(
        "$\\it{",
        gene,
        "}$ Gene Expression"
      )
    )

    histTitle <- TeX(
      paste0(
        "$\\it{",
        gene,
        "}$ Gene Expression Distribution"
      )
    )

    scatterTitle <- TeX(
      paste0(
        "Maternal Vitamin D and ",
        "$\\it{",
        gene,
        "}$ Expression"
      )
    )

    boxTitle <- TeX(
      paste0(
        "$\\it{",
        gene,
        "}$ Expression by Pregnancy Outcome and Maternal BMI"
      )
    )

    # Histogram
    histPlot <- ggplot(
      tempData,
      aes(x = geneExpression)
    ) +
      geom_histogram(
        bins = 30
      ) +
      labs(
        title = histTitle,
        x = geneAxis,
        y = "Frequency"
      ) +
      theme_classic()

    # Scatterplot
    scatterPlot <- ggplot(
      tempData,
      aes(
        x = mat_vitD,
        y = geneExpression
      )
    ) +
      geom_point() +
      geom_smooth(
        method = lm,
        se = FALSE
      ) +
      labs(
        title = scatterTitle,
        x = "Maternal Vitamin D (ng/mL)",
        y = geneAxis
      ) +
      theme_classic()

    # Boxplot
    boxPlot <- ggplot(
      tempData,
      aes(
        x = preg_preeclampsia,
        y = geneExpression,
        fill = BMIgroup
      )
    ) +
      geom_boxplot() +
      labs(
        title = boxTitle,
        x = "Pregnancy Outcome",
        y = geneAxis,
        fill = "Maternal BMI Group"
      ) +
      theme_classic()

    # Save histogram
    plotList[[
      paste0(
        gene,
        "_histogram"
      )
    ]] <- histPlot

    # Save scatterplot
    plotList[[
      paste0(
        gene,
        "_scatterplot"
      )
    ]] <- scatterPlot

    # Save boxplot
    plotList[[
      paste0(
        gene,
        "_boxplot"
      )
    ]] <- boxPlot
  }

  return(plotList)
}
```

```{r}

)
```

# Summary Statistics Table

```{r}
# Separate data by pregnancy outcome
normalData <- analysisData[
  analysisData$preg_preeclampsia == "Normal",
]

preeclampsiaData <- analysisData[
  analysisData$preg_preeclampsia == "Preeclampsia",
]

# Create empty summary table
summaryTable <- data.frame(
  Variable = character(),
  Normal = character(),
  Preeclampsia = character(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Maternal age
normalMean <- round(mean(normalData$mat_age_yrs,
                         na.rm = TRUE), 2)
normalSD <- round(sd(normalData$mat_age_yrs,
                     na.rm = TRUE), 2)

preeclampsiaMean <- round(mean(preeclampsiaData$mat_age_yrs,
                               na.rm = TRUE), 2)
preeclampsiaSD <- round(sd(preeclampsiaData$mat_age_yrs,
                           na.rm = TRUE), 2)

summaryTable <- rbind(
  summaryTable,
  data.frame(
    Variable = "Maternal Age, years",
    Normal = paste0(normalMean,
                    " (", normalSD, ")"),
    Preeclampsia = paste0(preeclampsiaMean,
                          " (", preeclampsiaSD, ")")
  )
)

# Maternal BMI
normalMean <- round(mean(normalData$mat_BMI,
                         na.rm = TRUE), 2)
normalSD <- round(sd(normalData$mat_BMI,
                     na.rm = TRUE), 2)

preeclampsiaMean <- round(mean(preeclampsiaData$mat_BMI,
                               na.rm = TRUE), 2)
preeclampsiaSD <- round(sd(preeclampsiaData$mat_BMI,
                           na.rm = TRUE), 2)

summaryTable <- rbind(
  summaryTable,
  data.frame(
    Variable = "Maternal BMI",
    Normal = paste0(normalMean,
                    " (", normalSD, ")"),
    Preeclampsia = paste0(preeclampsiaMean,
                          " (", preeclampsiaSD, ")")
  )
)

# Maternal vitamin D
normalMean <- round(mean(normalData$mat_vitD,
                         na.rm = TRUE), 2)
normalSD <- round(sd(normalData$mat_vitD,
                     na.rm = TRUE), 2)

preeclampsiaMean <- round(mean(preeclampsiaData$mat_vitD,
                               na.rm = TRUE), 2)
preeclampsiaSD <- round(sd(preeclampsiaData$mat_vitD,
                           na.rm = TRUE), 2)

summaryTable <- rbind(
  summaryTable,
  data.frame(
    Variable = "Maternal Vitamin D, ng/mL",
    Normal = paste0(normalMean,
                    " (", normalSD, ")"),
    Preeclampsia = paste0(preeclampsiaMean,
                          " (", preeclampsiaSD, ")")
  )
)

# BMI group header
summaryTable <- rbind(
  summaryTable,
  data.frame(
    Variable = "Maternal BMI Group",
    Normal = "",
    Preeclampsia = ""
  )
)

# BMI group categories
for (level in levels(analysisData$BMIgroup)) {

  normalN <- sum(normalData$BMIgroup == level,
                 na.rm = TRUE)

  normalPerc <- round(
    normalN / nrow(normalData) * 100,
    1
  )

  preeclampsiaN <- sum(
    preeclampsiaData$BMIgroup == level,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  preeclampsiaPerc <- round(
    preeclampsiaN /
      nrow(preeclampsiaData) * 100,
    1
  )

  summaryTable <- rbind(
    summaryTable,
    data.frame(
      Variable = paste0("  ", level),
      Normal = paste0(normalN,
                      " (", normalPerc, "%)"),
      Preeclampsia = paste0(preeclampsiaN,
                            " (", preeclampsiaPerc, "%)")
    )
  )
}

# Maternal asthma header
summaryTable <- rbind(
  summaryTable,
  data.frame(
    Variable = "Maternal Asthma",
    Normal = "",
    Preeclampsia = ""
  )
)

# Maternal asthma categories
for (level in levels(analysisData$mat_asthma)) {

  normalN <- sum(normalData$mat_asthma == level,
                 na.rm = TRUE)

  normalPerc <- round(
    normalN / nrow(normalData) * 100,
    1
  )

  preeclampsiaN <- sum(
    preeclampsiaData$mat_asthma == level,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  preeclampsiaPerc <- round(
    preeclampsiaN /
      nrow(preeclampsiaData) * 100,
    1
  )

  summaryTable <- rbind(
    summaryTable,
    data.frame(
      Variable = paste0("  ", level),
      Normal = paste0(normalN,
                      " (", normalPerc, "%)"),
      Preeclampsia = paste0(preeclampsiaN,
                            " (", preeclampsiaPerc, "%)")
    )
  )
}

# Display summary table
knitr::kable(
  summaryTable,
  caption = "Summary Statistics Stratified by Pregnancy Outcome",
  col.names = c(
    "Variable",
    paste0("Normal (n = ",
           nrow(normalData), ")"),
    paste0("Preeclampsia (n = ",
           nrow(preeclampsiaData), ")")
  ),
  align = c("l", "c", "c")
)
```

# Heatmap
```{r}
# Match gene names to probes in the expression data
heatmapGeneMap <- geneNames[
  rownames(geneNames) %in% rownames(geneExpression),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

# Save probe IDs
heatmapGeneMap$PROBEID <- rownames(heatmapGeneMap)

# Remove missing gene names
heatmapGeneMap <- heatmapGeneMap[
  !is.na(heatmapGeneMap$GENE),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

# Calculate variance for each probe
geneVariance <- apply(
  geneExpression,
  1,
  var
)

# Add variance to gene map
heatmapGeneMap$Variance <-
  geneVariance[heatmapGeneMap$PROBEID]

# Remove genes already used in Submission 2
additionalGenes <- heatmapGeneMap[
  !(heatmapGeneMap$GENE %in% selectedGenes),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

# Put highest variance genes first
additionalGenes <- additionalGenes[
  order(
    additionalGenes$Variance,
    decreasing = TRUE
  ),
]

# Remove duplicate gene names
additionalGenes <- additionalGenes[
  !duplicated(additionalGenes$GENE),
]

# Select top 7 additional genes
additionalGenes <- additionalGenes[1:7, ]

# Combine with the 3 selected genes
heatmapGenes <- c(
  selectedGenes,
  additionalGenes$GENE
)

# Check selected genes
heatmapGenes
length(heatmapGenes)
```

# Additional Plot

```{r}
# Create empty data frame for mean differences
lollipopData <- data.frame(
  Gene = character(),
  Difference = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Identify normal and preeclampsia samples
normalSamples <- analysisData$geoID[
  analysisData$preg_preeclampsia == "Normal"
]

preeclampsiaSamples <- analysisData$geoID[
  analysisData$preg_preeclampsia == "Preeclampsia"
]

# Calculate mean expression difference for each gene
for (gene in heatmapGenes) {

  normalMean <- mean(
    heatmapData[
      gene,
      normalSamples
    ],
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  preeclampsiaMean <- mean(
    heatmapData[
      gene,
      preeclampsiaSamples
    ],
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  meanDifference <- preeclampsiaMean - normalMean

  lollipopData <- rbind(
    lollipopData,
    data.frame(
      Gene = gene,
      Difference = meanDifference
    )
  )
}

# Order genes by mean difference
lollipopData <- lollipopData[
  order(lollipopData$Difference),
]

# Set gene order
lollipopData$Gene <- factor(
  lollipopData$Gene,
  levels = lollipopData$Gene
)

# Check data
lollipopData
```
```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
# Create lollipop plot
ggplot(
  lollipopData,
  aes(
    x = Difference,
    y = Gene
  )
) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(
      x = 0,
      xend = Difference,
      y = Gene,
      yend = Gene
    )
  ) +
  geom_point(
    size = 3
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Mean Gene Expression Differences by Pregnancy Outcome",
    x = "Mean Expression Difference (Preeclampsia - Normal)",
    y = "Gene"
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(
    labels = function(x) {
      parse(
        text = paste0(
          "italic('",
          x,
          "')"
        )
      )
    }
  ) +
  theme_classic()
```
